_purpose: The committed artefact the SPACE CHECK's control verifies against (script/m14/ontology-coverage-gate.ts, spaceCheckSelfTest). The numbers are fixed on purpose: the control's arms B and C must read real values through a real JSON pointer, and arm F must be able to fail when a declaration contradicts the file. This file is NOT a measurement of anything — the HCL measurement is validation/m14/fixtures/hcl/construct-census.current.json.
_placement: JSON, so completeness-inventory's emittedKinds scan (every top-level non-.json file in a fixtures directory) skips it.
